meta.note: IS=2025 (limited regime diversity: all tnx>=3, vix mostly 15-25). OOS=2026 is single tape (all above-200d, ~all positive momentum). OOS_regime=2022-23 is the only genuinely different rate/vol tape but tradeable n small.

baseline_unconditional_excess.comment: No unconditional alpha in any split; regime splits slice a ~zero-mean noisy distribution.

xbi_above_200d==0 (weak tape).OOS_2026: UNTESTABLE - 2026 has 0 below-200d rows (single above-200d tape)
xbi_above_200d==0 (weak tape).why: Tradeable hold-out (2022-23, n=9) flips NEGATIVE (-4.6%); fullset positive but insignificant (boot CI incl 0). Cannot be tested in 2026.

xbi_mom_63d<0 (neg momentum).why: Sign FLIPS negative in BOTH hold-outs (2026 n=5 mean -10.0%; 2022-23 n=9 mean -4.6%). 0.80 collinear with below-200d.

rates_rising (tnx_chg>0).why: Only IS regime significant on BOTH boot & sign tests, BUT most outcome-mix-confounded (83.9% vs 71.2% approvals; outcome unknown at entry). OOS 2026 keeps positive sign but loses significance (boot CI [-1.5,+4.4] incl 0). 2022-23 tradeable flips negative.

collinearity.comment: The 3 IS-positive regimes are ~1 independent bet (weak XBI tape), not 3.

verdict.multiple_testing: ~11 splits tested on IS; ~0.5-1 false positive expected at p<0.05. Positives are collinear and none replicate.
verdict.FINAL_VERDICT: NO regime shows positive significant XBI-excess that survives the hold-out. In-sample edge concentrates in the weak-XBI-tape regimes (below-200d MA / negative 3-mo momentum / rising rates in 2025), which are mutually collinear (~1 bet), partly outcome-mix confounded, untestable in the 2026 single-tape hold-out, and sign-flip negative in the 2022-23 hold-out. Consistent with a single-tape / multiple-testing artifact, not exploitable alpha.
